description: Personal health metrics collected directly from Health Connect.

panels.description: Canonical daily steps: Health Connect when available, otherwise Samsung Health. Workout step summaries are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.value_numeric), 0) AS "Steps Today"
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) < ((date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')

panels.title: Steps Today

panels.description: Longest non-awake sleep session for the latest local wake date. Segments separated by more than 30 minutes form different sessions; shorter sessions are shown as naps below.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends, lower(r.value_text) AS stage
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light', 'deep', 'rem', 'awake')
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= now() - interval '14 days'), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN starts > lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) + interval '30 minutes'
                     OR lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM base
), segmented AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(new_session) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) AS session_id FROM marked
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, (MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date,
         SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') AS asleep_seconds
  FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY asleep_seconds DESC) AS rank_for_day FROM sessions
)
SELECT asleep_seconds / 3600.0 AS "Primary Sleep (h)" FROM ranked
WHERE rank_for_day = 1 ORDER BY wake_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Latest direct heart-rate measurement. Workout track samples and workout summary averages are shown separately below.

targets.rawSql:

FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'heart_rate' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct' AND r.unit = 'count/min'
ORDER BY text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) DESC LIMIT 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS "time", r.value_numeric AS "Heart Rate",
  AVG(r.value_numeric) OVER (ORDER BY text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND 9 FOLLOWING) AS "10-pt Moving Avg"
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'heart_rate' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct' AND r.unit = 'count/min'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
)
SELECT date_trunc('hour', observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "time", SUM(value_numeric) AS "Steps"
FROM recent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
), hourly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS hour, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps
  FROM recent GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT hour AS "time", AVG(steps) OVER (ORDER BY hour ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Rolling Avg (3h)" FROM hourly ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time)) AS "time",
       SUM(r.value_numeric) AS "Total Calories"
FROM health_observations_raw r
WHERE r.metric_type = 'calories'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AS "time",
  value_numeric AS "SpO₂"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'oxygen_saturation'
  AND unit = '%'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends, lower(r.value_text) AS stage
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light', 'deep', 'rem', 'awake')
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN starts > lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) + interval '30 minutes'
                     OR lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM base
), segmented AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(new_session) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) AS session_id FROM marked
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, (MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date,
         SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') AS asleep_seconds
  FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id
), latest AS (
  SELECT session_id FROM sessions ORDER BY wake_date DESC, asleep_seconds DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT MIN(starts) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "Sleep start (ET)", MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "Wake time (ET)",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts)))/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Tracked hours",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage<>'awake')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Asleep hours"
FROM segmented JOIN latest USING (session_id)

SELECT date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "time",
  MIN(r.value_numeric) AS "min", AVG(r.value_numeric) AS "avg", MAX(r.value_numeric) AS "max"
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type='heart_rate' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct' AND r.unit='count/min' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time)>=$__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time)<=$__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends, lower(r.value_text) AS stage
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light', 'deep', 'rem', 'awake')
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz - interval '1 day' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN starts > lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) + interval '30 minutes'
                     OR lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM base
), segmented AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(new_session) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) AS session_id FROM marked
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, (MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date,
         SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') AS asleep_seconds
  FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY asleep_seconds DESC) AS rank_for_day FROM sessions
)
SELECT (r.wake_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='light') / 3600.0 AS "Light",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='deep') / 3600.0 AS "Deep",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='rem') / 3600.0 AS "REM",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='awake') / 3600.0 AS "Awake"
FROM segmented s JOIN ranked r USING (session_id)
WHERE r.rank_for_day=1 AND r.wake_date BETWEEN (($__timeFrom())::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AND (($__timeTo())::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date
GROUP BY r.wake_date ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends, lower(r.value_text) AS stage
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light', 'deep', 'rem', 'awake')
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= now()-interval '14 days'), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN starts > lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) + interval '30 minutes'
                     OR lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM base
), segmented AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(new_session) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) AS session_id FROM marked
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, (MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date,
         SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') AS asleep_seconds
  FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id
), latest AS (SELECT session_id FROM sessions ORDER BY wake_date DESC, asleep_seconds DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT stage AS "metric", SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts)))/3600.0 AS "hours" FROM segmented JOIN latest USING (session_id) GROUP BY stage ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz-interval '6 days' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
), daily AS (
  SELECT (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps FROM recent GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time", steps AS "Steps", AVG(steps) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "7d Avg" FROM daily WHERE day >= (($__timeFrom())::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date ORDER BY day

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz-interval '6 days' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
), daily AS (
  SELECT (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps FROM recent GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (date_trunc('week', day::timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time", SUM(steps) AS "Steps" FROM daily GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  SUM(value_numeric) AS "active_energy"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'active_energy'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
  AND unit IN ('Cal', 'kcal')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  SUM(value_numeric) AS "distance_m"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'distance'
  AND unit = 'm'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT metric_type AS "Metric",
       max(text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time)) AS "Last seen",
       now() - max(text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time)) AS "Age",
       count(*) AS "Rows"
FROM health_observations_raw
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Full bounds, stage durations, tracked time, asleep time, efficiency, and awake episodes for the latest primary session.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts, text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends, lower(r.value_text) AS stage
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='sleep_segment'  AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light','deep','rem','awake') AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time)>=now()-interval '14 days'
), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN starts>lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts,ends)+interval '30 minutes' OR lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts,ends) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session FROM base
), segmented AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(new_session) OVER (ORDER BY starts,ends) AS session_id FROM marked
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, (MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage<>'awake') AS asleep_seconds FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id
), latest AS (
  SELECT session_id FROM sessions ORDER BY wake_date DESC, asleep_seconds DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT MIN(starts) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "Sleep start (ET)", MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "Wake time (ET)",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts)))/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Tracked hours", ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage<>'awake')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Asleep hours",
  ROUND((100.0*SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage<>'awake')/NULLIF(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))),0))::numeric,1) AS "Efficiency %",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage='light')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Light h", ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage='deep')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Deep h",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage='rem')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "REM h", ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage='awake')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Awake h", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage='awake') AS "Awake episodes"
FROM segmented JOIN latest USING (session_id)

targets.rawSql:

FROM health_observations_raw r

panels.description: Side-by-side daily source totals expose overlaps and gaps. The canonical value chooses Health Connect first, then Samsung Health.

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric, r.original_type, s.source_name
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='steps' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time)>=$__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time)<=$__timeTo()
), daily AS (
  SELECT (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, source_name, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps FROM recent WHERE original_type='health_sync_steps' GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT day AS "Local day", MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Health Connect') AS "Health Connect", MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Samsung Health') AS "Samsung Health", COALESCE(MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Health Connect'),MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Samsung Health')) AS "Canonical"
FROM daily GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

panels.title: Workout Step Summaries
Lifetime Trends (one source per day, deduplicated)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (summary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       value_numeric AS "Steps",
       AVG(value_numeric) OVER (ORDER BY summary_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "30d Avg"
FROM health_daily_summaries
WHERE metric_type = 'steps' AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
ORDER BY 1

SELECT (summary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time", value_numeric AS "Resting HR"
FROM health_daily_summaries
WHERE metric_type = 'resting_heart_rate' AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
ORDER BY 1

SELECT (summary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time", value_numeric AS "Weight"
FROM health_daily_summaries
WHERE metric_type = 'weight' AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
ORDER BY 1

SELECT (summary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='heart_rate_min') AS "Min",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='heart_rate')     AS "Avg",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='heart_rate_max') AS "Max"
FROM health_daily_summaries
WHERE metric_type IN ('heart_rate','heart_rate_min','heart_rate_max') AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (summary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='active_energy') AS "Active",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='basal_energy')  AS "Basal",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='calories')      AS "Total"
FROM health_daily_summaries
WHERE metric_type IN ('active_energy','basal_energy','calories') AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (summary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       value_numeric / 1000.0 AS "Distance"
FROM health_daily_summaries
WHERE metric_type = 'distance' AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
ORDER BY 1

SELECT (summary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='sleep_deep_hours')  AS "Deep",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='sleep_rem_hours')   AS "REM",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='sleep_light_hours') AS "Light",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='sleep_awake_hours') AS "Awake"
FROM health_daily_summaries
WHERE metric_type LIKE 'sleep\_%\_hours' AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (summary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='oxygen_saturation') AS "SpO2 %",
       MAX(value_numeric) FILTER (WHERE metric_type='respiratory_rate')  AS "Breaths/min"
FROM health_daily_summaries
WHERE metric_type IN ('oxygen_saturation','respiratory_rate') AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS "time",
       r.value_numeric AS "$metric",
       s.source_system AS metric
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = '$metric'
  AND s.source_system IN ($source_system)
  AND r.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Which source won, per metric (selected day range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metric_type AS "Metric", source_system AS "Winning source",
       count(*) AS "Days won", round(avg(priority)) AS "Priority"
FROM health_daily_source_comparison
WHERE selected AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

SELECT summary_date AS "Day", source_system AS "Source",
       source_name AS "Device/App", round(value_numeric::numeric,2) AS "Value",
       unit AS "Unit", priority AS "Priority",
       CASE WHEN selected THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS "Used"
FROM health_daily_source_comparison
WHERE metric_type = '$metric' AND summary_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::date AND ($__timeTo())::date
ORDER BY summary_date DESC, priority DESC LIMIT 500
